goal_and_scope: Audit pure-state mean-rate identification, finite-time secants, minimality, and robust finite-action mean-population reach-avoid under rate confidence sets.
inherited_inputs: Parent's Cycle 2 candidate and no-spawn constraint
representation_and_assumptions: Row switching generator Q, mean count column x'=(Q^T+diag(r))x, r net growth; for each finite action u, matrix A_u lies in a joint confidence set, is time-constant per use, and is Metzler. Reach-avoid is over mean composition on a fixed time grid.
exact_missing_lemma: No novel initial-slope identification theorem survives the prior-art check. Narrow internal addition: explicit rate-cap secant bias bounds and a conservative interval-hull schedule certificate; external novelty and practical value UNKNOWN.
comparator: Gunnarsson-Foo-Leder branching-process estimator/CIs, Transcompp estimator/resampling, existing cell-switching schedule optimization, plus an exposure-matched held-out schedule benchmark.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Measure sorted pure-state populations, absolute counts/fractions at several short times, actual treatment exposure, and independent biological replicates; test bounds and confidence coverage on holdouts before optimizing/certifying a schedule.
status_note: The exact first-derivative statement is externally established prior art. The finite-time and robust schedule results are conditional internal derivations, not evidence that cells obey the model.
